Delimiter Test Beast
Medium Undead, Chaotic Evil
Armor Class 15
Hit Points 40 (5d8 + 15)
Speed 30 ft.
STR 14 (+2)
DEX 16 (+3)
CON 18 (+4)
INT 10 (+0)
WIS 11 (+0)
CHA 14 (+2)
Challenge 4 (1,100 XP)
Traits
Hit-and-Run. The beast strikes and immediately withdraws from reach.
Actions
Multiattack. The beast makes two Claw attacks.
Icy Blast (Recharge 5-6). The beast exhales a cone of frost at its foes.
Bonus Actions
All Hands: The beast rallies its allies with a shriek.
Second Wind — The beast regains a handful of hit points instantly.
Reactions
Not Yet!
The beast refuses to fall and stays standing despite the wound.
